handler.query: SELECT name, value, help, type, labels FROM ( SELECT 'basketline_newest_event_age_seconds' AS name, toFloat64(dateDiff('second', max(ingested_at), now64(3))) AS value, 'Seconds since ClickHouse last stored an event' AS help, 'gauge' AS type, CAST(map(), 'Map(String, String)') AS labels FROM analytics.events UNION ALL SELECT 'basketline_hourly_check_failed', toFloat64(ifNull(exception, '') != ''), '1 when the last run of an hourly check failed', 'gauge', map('view', view) FROM system.view_refreshes WHERE database = 'analytics' UNION ALL SELECT 'basketline_hourly_check_age_seconds', toFloat64(dateDiff('second', ifNull(last_success_time, toDateTime(0)), now())), 'Seconds since an hourly check last succeeded', 'gauge', map('view', view) FROM system.view_refreshes WHERE database = 'analytics' UNION ALL SELECT 'basketline_backup_age_seconds', toFloat64(dateDiff('second', max(event_time), now())), 'Seconds since the newest completed backup (a very large value: none yet)', 'gauge', CAST(map(), 'Map(String, String)') FROM system.backup_log WHERE status = 'BACKUP_CREATED' UNION ALL SELECT 'basketline_invalid_traffic_today', toFloat64(sum(events)), 'Events refused today as invalid traffic, per tenant and reason', 'gauge', map('tenant', toString(tenant_id), 'reason', toString(reason)) FROM analytics.invalid_traffic_daily WHERE day = today() GROUP BY tenant_id, reason UNION ALL SELECT 'basketline_seller_events_last_hour', toFloat64(count()), 'Events stored in the last hour, per seller', 'gauge', map('tenant', toString(e.tenant_id), 'seller', toString(assumeNotNull(e.seller_id)), 'seller_name', ifNull(any(s.name), '')) FROM analytics.events AS e LEFT JOIN (SELECT seller_id, tenant_id, argMax(name, version) AS name FROM analytics.sellers GROUP BY seller_id, tenant_id) AS s ON s.seller_id = e.seller_id AND s.tenant_id = e.tenant_id WHERE e.ingested_at > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND e.seller_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.tenant_id, e.seller_id ) ORDER BY name FORMAT Prometheus
